happy: PlantFam buddy, MOOD = HAPPY. Plant: a heart fern (Hemionitis arifolia): a compact, upright little fern, a neat dome of about 12 to 15 small, glossy, leathery, plain dark-green HEART-shaped (arrow-like) fronds, each held up on its own thin, wiry, dark brown-black stem. A few slightly smaller, longer arrow-shaped fertile fronds stand a little taller in the middle. No variegation, no trailing vines, no flowers. Smaller and tidier than other ferns. Pot: bubblegum #FFB3C7.
